name: Frog Grog
review:
Frog Grog is a 23-line witch's-brew slot with wild frogs, a mystery game and an increasing multiplier.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 1,616x cap and a 96.1% RTP. A playful, approachable game.

The mystery game and the increasing multiplier keep things moving without big swings, which makes Frog Grog a good choice for long, low-stakes demo sessions. The bubbling-cauldron art is very charming.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
